objective:
Implement spec 020 (build/release native + mobile polish) for services/agents-ui. Two parts: (A) extend `.github/workflows/release.yml` with native Android + iOS release jobs (secret-gated, NON-destructive — preserve ALL existing jobs incl. the agents-ui publish-images matrix row), and (B) Capacitor mobile polish in services/agents-ui (verifiable via existing ci.yml app-web-check + app-android-smoke). Do NOT edit `.github/workflows/ci.yml` (spec 016 owns it). Match repo conventions + antfu lint for any TS/Vue.

PART A — `.github/workflows/release.yml` (currently: a `release-please` job with outputs `tag_name`/`release_created`, and a `publish-images` matrix job gated `if: always() && (needs.release-please.outputs.release_created == 'true' || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch')` building images at ref `needs.release-please.outputs.tag_name || github.sha`). ADD:
  - job `native-android` (needs: release-please; same gating expr as publish-images; runs-on ubuntu-latest): checkout at `ref: ${{ needs.release-please.outputs.tag_name || github.sha }}`; setup-java@v5 temurin 21; android-actions/setup-android@v3; pnpm/action-setup@v6 (version 9.15.4) + setup-node@v6 node 22; install deps with the repo's GitHub Packages npm pattern (`pnpm config set //npm.pkg.github.com/:_authToken "$NODE_AUTH_TOKEN"` then `pnpm install --no-frozen-lockfile`); build web (`pnpm --filter @extratoast/agents-ui build`); `npx cap add android` + `npx cap sync android` in services/agents-ui; build the release bundle `./gradlew bundleRelease` in services/agents-ui/android. Then SECRET-GATED signing+publish that must NOT fail when secrets are absent: decode an `ANDROID_KEYSTORE_BASE64` secret + sign ONLY when present (gate via a step that sets `has_keystore` from `${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEYSTORE_BASE64 != '' }}` and subsequent steps `if: steps.x.outputs.has_keystore == 'true'`); upload the AAB as a build artifact (actions/upload-artifact) always; upload to Google Play internal track ONLY when `ANDROID_PLAY_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON` secret is present (conditional step). Never echo secrets.
  - job `native-ios` (needs: release-please; runs-on macos-latest; gated to MANUAL/RELEASE only: `if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' || needs.release-please.outputs.release_created == 'true'`): checkout at the same ref; setup-node + pnpm install (same npm auth pattern); build web; `npx cap add ios` + `npx cap sync ios`; build the app for the simulator without code signing as a smoke (`xcodebuild -workspace ios/App/App.xcworkspace -scheme App -sdk iphonesimulator -configuration Release CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build` — adjust path to the generated workspace under services/agents-ui/ios). Add a comment that signed IPA archive + TestFlight upload requires Apple signing secrets (operator-provided) and is intentionally not run without them. NO OTA update mechanism. Add `workflow_dispatch:` to the workflow `on:` triggers if not already present so native-ios can be run manually.
  Keep the workflow VALID (it is checked by the repo's workflow-lint CI job). Use existing `env.NODE_AUTH_TOKEN`/`GITHUB_TOKEN` if defined at workflow level, else add them like ci.yml does. Do not change the release-please or publish-images jobs except as needed to keep them working.

PART B — Capacitor mobile polish (services/agents-ui):
  - package.json: add deps `@capacitor/splash-screen` ^7 and `@capacitor/status-bar` ^7.
  - capacitor.config.ts: add a `plugins` section configuring SplashScreen (launchAutoHide true, short duration, background matching the app theme) and StatusBar; keep existing appId/appName/webDir/server.
  - Native init: in the scaffold platform-registration slot (src/main.ts) or via the existing src/platform abstraction, on NATIVE platforms only (Capacitor.isNativePlatform()) hide the splash screen after mount and set the status bar style; on web this must be a no-op (dynamically import the plugins so the web bundle does not require them at load). Keep web build/behavior identical.
  - Mobile CSS: add iOS/Android safe-area handling — `viewport-fit=cover` on the viewport meta (index.html) and `env(safe-area-inset-*)` padding on the app shell root (src/index.css or the shell) so content avoids notches/home indicator. Keep it minimal and non-breaking for web/desktop.
  - If adding the plugins requires a unit test touch, add a small test that the web no-op path does not import native plugins eagerly.

Constraints: pass ci.yml gates — `workflow-lint` (valid workflows), `app-web-check` (typecheck/lint/test/build with the new deps), `app-android-smoke` (cap add + assembleDebug still works), and Docker builds. Do NOT break existing release.yml jobs. antfu lint for any TS/Vue changes (import order, etc.). No secrets in source or logs.
verify: grep -q 'native-android' .github/workflows/release.yml && grep -q 'native-ios' .github/workflows/release.yml && grep -q 'publish-images' .github/workflows/release.yml && grep -q '@capacitor/splash-screen' services/agents-ui/package.json && grep -q 'safe-area-inset' services/agents-ui/src/index.css services/agents-ui/index.html
